name: Lord Shalzaru
summary: On the Isle of Dread, Lord Shalzaru rules the Hatecrest naga by cruelty. His followers dig through ruined elven settlements, and the ancient relic he uncovered now draws mainland investigators.

sections.title: Master of the Hatecrest
sections.body: Along Feralas’s southern coast, Lord Shalzaru commands the Hatecrest naga. From his cavern lair on the Isle of Dread, he rules by force and cruelty. His followers search Kalimdor’s ancient ruins for forgotten treasures and powerful relics left by the Sundering.

sections.title: The Mysterious Relic
sections.body: South of the main ruins on the Isle of Dread, Lord Shalzaru uncovered a strange ancient relic. Its purpose and power remain unknown, yet it is now held by a powerful naga warlord. Mainland operatives seek champions to enter his lair, end his command, and secure the relic before the Hatecrest turn it to darker ends.

faq.answer: Lord Shalzaru commands the Hatecrest naga and their excavations on the Isle of Dread, off Feralas’s coast.

faq.q: Where can Lord Shalzaru be found?
faq.answer: Lord Shalzaru lairs in a cave south of the main elven ruins on the Isle of Dread, off Feralas’s southwestern coast.
The Hatecrest are a hostile naga tribe along Feralas’s coast and islands. Under Shalzaru’s command, they search ancient ruins and terrorize coastal waters.

faq.q: What relic does Lord Shalzaru possess?
faq.answer: Lord Shalzaru uncovered a mysterious ancient relic of unknown origin and power during an excavation on the Isle of Dread. Mainland factions seek champions to claim it.

faq.q: Why must Lord Shalzaru be defeated?
faq.answer: Defeating Lord Shalzaru breaks Hatecrest leadership on the Isle of Dread and lets champions recover his relic before the naga can harness it.

faq.q: What are the Hatecrest digging for in Feralas?
faq.answer: The Hatecrest search ruined Night Elf settlements shattered in the Great Sundering. They seek powerful magical relics and remnants of Highborne history beneath soil and waves.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you know the Hatecrest violate Kalimdor’s ancient ruins. Reclaiming Shalzaru’s relic keeps the Highborne’s dark legacy from empowering his naga kin.
As an Alliance member, securing Shalzaru’s relic and stopping the Hatecrest warlord helps protect remote Alliance outposts on Feralas’s untamed coast.
As a member of the Horde, you know scouts watch Feralas’s coastal threats. Striking down the naga lord removes an unpredictable danger near Camp Mojache’s sphere of interest.
